text: No em dashes anywhere you write: code, comments, docs, commit messages, PR text, brain files. Use a colon, a comma or a new sentence. brain doctor checks .brain/, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.

Anything new in the guard or preflight fails closed: a request, body or reply that cannot be parsed or judged is refused, never waved through. Tests for a new rule include the malformed and encoded variants, not just the plain one.

judge.py stays pure: no browser, no model, no network. Anything a verdict depends on must be recorded in evidence.json first, so `swarm-persona replay` and `tickets` rebuild the same findings from a saved run. tests/fixtures/run/evidence.json is a saved run the tests replay.

Commit subjects read `Area: what changed; what else changed`, plain words, no prefixes like feat:, no attribution lines. A release commit is just the version (`0.2.0`), and the annotated tag message summarises it.
